types.name: AuditEvent
types.description: A single Account Activity event. Presentation (sentence, icon, category, diff rendering) is constructed client-side from `kind`, `changes`, and `actorKind`.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: The user who performed the action, resolved to their record in the viewing account. Non-null only when `actorKind` is IN_ACCOUNT; otherwise null (use `actorKind` to render the actor).

fields.name: actorIsSystem
fields.description: Legacy compatibility field. True when the action was performed by the system rather than a user.

fields.name: actorKind
fields.description: How to present the actor: IN_ACCOUNT (real name in `actor`), FRANCHISE_ADMIN, EXTERNAL, SYSTEM, or DELETED. The frontend owns the label copy for the non-IN_ACCOUNT kinds.

fields.name: changes
fields.description: Allow-listed subset of the underlying audit row's target_changes, redacted per kind. The raw target_changes jsonb is never returned. See the design doc for the per-kind allow-list.

fields.name: hasSubject
fields.description: True when the event targets a specific user.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Classification driving the frontend's rendering. New kinds are additive; clients SHOULD render unknown kinds as a generic 'Activity recorded' fallback rather than failing.

fields.name: occurredAt
fields.description: When the action was performed.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The user whose record was changed, resolved to their record in the viewing account. Null when the event has no per-user subject; use `hasSubject` to distinguish.

types.name: AuditEventActorKind
types.description: How the actor of an Account Activity event should be presented. The backend classifies; the frontend owns the copy. Clients SHOULD treat an unknown value as a generic non-identifiable actor.

enumValues.name: IN_ACCOUNT
enumValues.description: The actor is a member of the viewing account (directly or via a franchise alias). `actor.displayName` is present.

enumValues.name: FRANCHISE_ADMIN
enumValues.description: A franchise administrator acting from another account in the same franchise, with no record in the viewing account. No specific identity is exposed.

enumValues.name: EXTERNAL
enumValues.description: A real user acting from outside the viewing account who is not a confirmed same-franchise admin (for example a support or delegate action). No specific identity is exposed.

enumValues.name: SYSTEM
enumValues.description: A system (non-user) action.

enumValues.name: DELETED
enumValues.description: The actor references a user who is no longer present.

types.name: OptimizedGoogleProfile
types.description: Recommended values for a Google Business profile

fields.name: fieldStatuses
fields.description: Per-field live/pending status, derived from Google's `pendingMask`. Empty when the status could not be determined — no Google Business Profile connected, the lookup failed, or Google returned no serving snapshot — so treat empty as unknown rather than as everything being live. Empty exactly when `liveProfile` is null.

fields.name: liveProfile
fields.description: The Google Business Profile values Google is currently serving on Maps and Search. For a field with an edit still processing this is the value customers see today, while `originalProfile` holds the pending one. Do not assume a pending edit is the only reason the two differ: Google also makes its own updates to a listing (reported separately via `diffMask`, which this payload does not yet surface), and such a field diverges while still reporting LIVE. Null when no Google Business Profile is connected, when either fetch fails, or when Google returns no serving snapshot. `attributes` and `socialLinks` are carried over from `originalProfile` — they come from a separate endpoint with no notion of pending edits, so they are not covered by `fieldStatuses` and are not guaranteed to be the serving values.

fields.name: optimizedProfile
fields.description: The optimizer's proposed Google Business Profile.

fields.name: originalProfile
fields.description: Google's local preferred values for the SP's profile — the most recent values submitted to Google. For a field with an edit still processing this is the **pending** value, not what customers currently see; use `liveProfile` for the serving values. Null when no Google Business Profile is connected or when the fetch fails; the fetch-failure case is signalled by a userErrors entry with code "ORIGINAL_FETCH_FAILED" and path ["originalProfile"].

fields.name: primaryPhotoUrl
fields.description: Google-hosted URL for the SP's current GBP primary photo (PROFILE → COVER → LOGO → first available). Null when no GBP is connected, no media exists, or Google returned an error. URL is not stable — Google warns it may change over time, so do not cache.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: The SP's current Google Business Profile rating (average of all non-deleted reviews). Null when the account does not have the automated_reviews feature, when no GBP is connected, or when no reviews exist yet.

fields.name: reviewCount
fields.description: The number of non-deleted Google Business Profile reviews on the SP's account. Null when the account does not have the automated_reviews feature or no GBP is connected. Zero when the feature is enabled but no reviews exist yet.

fields.name: userErrors
fields.description: Errors identified when optimizing the Google profile

types.name: SocialMarketingItemDisplayStatus
types.description: Display-level status for a marketing item on the Social Post tab. These values are a UI-facing projection of the underlying MarketingItemStatus, collapsing `unscheduled` and `generated` into DRAFT or MISSED based on the scheduled date in the account's local timezone.

enumValues.name: DRAFT
enumValues.description: An item that has not been scheduled, or whose scheduled date is today or in the future (maps to status IN (unscheduled, generated) AND (start_at IS NULL OR start_at >= today)).

enumValues.name: SCHEDULED
enumValues.description: An item scheduled to be sent (status = scheduled).

enumValues.name: SENT
enumValues.description: An item that has been sent (status = sent).

enumValues.name: FAILED
enumValues.description: An item whose delivery failed (status = failed).

enumValues.name: MISSED
enumValues.description: An item whose scheduled date has passed without being approved (maps to status IN (unscheduled, generated) AND start_at < today).

inputFields.name: displayStatuses
inputFields.description: Filter to items whose display status matches any value in the list (OR within the list). Each value maps to one or more underlying MarketingItemStatus values; see the enum description.

inputFields.name: suggestionTypes
inputFields.description: Filter to items whose suggestion type matches any value in the list (OR within the list).

inputFields.name: searchTerm
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the associated SocialMediaPost's `title` meta value. Empty or whitespace-only values are a no-op.

inputFields.description: Narrow the result to a subset of the social channels (OR within the list). The enum is intentionally restricted to the two social channels (FACEBOOK, GOOGLE_BUSINESS_PROFILE) so non-social channels cannot be supplied. Omitted or empty means no additional narrowing — both social channels are returned.

inputFields.name: author
inputFields.description: Filter to items whose `author` label matches any value in the list (OR within the list), e.g. `["Marketing Agent", "Alice Brown"]`. When the list includes `"Marketing Agent"`, rows with a NULL author column are also matched (legacy / background-created items). Omitted or empty means no narrowing.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.

enumValues.name: QUERY
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a query operation.

enumValues.name: MUTATION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a mutation operation.

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION

enumValues.name: FIELD

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION

enumValues.name: ENUM

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: queryType

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name and description, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields` and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.
